{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''T-XL''''' was a group of 6 [[Utility Tug/Legends|Utility Tug]]s used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] they were located at a Rebel starfighter depot consisting of 2 groups of 3 [[Class-A cargo container]]s [[Vic]] and [[Limi]]. The tugs were scrambling to ferry pilots to the stationary [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], but were all destroyed by a single [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]], along with the fighters and finally the containers.
